text:
elaine: FYI bringing up kunoichi-v1 int8 on staging. smoke evals flagged two locale-y regressions.

park: what did the smoke show?

elaine: (1) zh->en outputs sometimes drop narrow no-break spaces and reattach parentheses differently when ZWJ sequences appear; (2) he/iw mixed RTL lines flip brackets and lose trailing question marks.

omar: only on int8? kernels?

elaine: repro only on int8 with matmul-v3 + fused-softmax. fp32/q4 behave normally.

tess: any sample diffs/metrics?

elaine: quick metrics on small onboard subset:
```
fp32 BLEU=29.6, COMET=0.39
int8 BLEU=25.0, COMET=0.11
Delta BLEU -4.6, COMET -0.28
```

elaine: example zh: "（您好\u200d）\u4f60\u597d\uff1f"  (ZWJ between fullwidth paren and token)
elaine: fp32 -> "(Hello) How are you?"
elaine: int8 -> ")Hello( How are you"   <-- paren order flipped, missing final ?

omar: hebrew sample?

elaine: src: "\u05d4\u05d0\u05ea \u05d4\u05de\u05e8\u05e9\u0028API\u0029\u05d4\u05d4\u05e0\u05d0?"
elaine: fp32 -> "Can I use (API) now?"
elaine: int8 -> "Can I use )API( now"  <-- bracket flip and dropped question mark

park: token id traces?

elaine: short raw id traces show inserted 0 token in int8 before punctuation in mixed-dir contexts:
```
fp32 ids: [7812, 14, 900, 4401]
int8 ids: [7812, 14, 0, 900, 4401]
```

tess: 0 insertion would break detok and bidi. Could be sampling from quantized softmax or a stray zeroed kv slot.

omar: agree. Hypotheses: (A) fused-softmax quant rounding yields near-0 id picks; (B) matmul-v3 transpose changed memory stride causing a stale zero in the output buffer; (C) postprocess trimming misfires on short trailing bytes.

park: run repro: `./infra/repro_locale.sh --model kunoichi-v1 --profile int8-v3 --cases zh-zwj,he-brackets`

ci-bot: pipeline: locale-repro started (run id rl-2026-03-21-174999)

elaine: pasted minimal repro log:
```
[repro] model=kunoichi-v1 int8-v3
[repro] case=zh-zwj
[repro] generated_ids: ... 4401, 0, 23
[repro] detok => ")Hello( How are you"
```

tess: short-term guard: strip NUL/0 tokens and collapse adjacent punctuation before bidi-detok. add to detok as a sanitizer while kernel is investigated.

omar: i'll run asan+svmap on matmul-v3 with mixed-direction inputs. ETA ~4h.

park: add two onboard smoke checks: zh-zwj-paren-preserve and he-bracket-punct-preserve. Block int8 merge if failures.

elaine: filed ML-1822 with samples, traces and metrics (internal link: https://redwood-internal/p/ML-1822). tagging the runtime and tokenizer teams.

tess: i'll open a small PR for detok guard and the two smoke tests. marked high-priority in CI.

ci-bot: staging-int8 rollout paused pending ML-1822 verification

elaine: thanks all 64f keeping thread live with traces/rollups here."
